notes.title: Contract of Swarm Hunter 1.2.1 Update
Contract of Zerg Hunter 1.2.0 Update
Contract of Swarm Hunter 1.1.0 Update
Contract of Swarm Hunter 1.0.0 Update
notes.content:
Added multi-route roadmap gameplay, new enemy lineups, and crafting optimization features! Next up: game performance improvements for a smoother experience!

		[h2]Changelog[/h2]

		[h3]New Content[/h3]

		[list]
		[*] Added Roadmap: Diverse combat paths and rich rewards await—adventures and treasures are yours to choose!
		[*] New Enemies: A batch of new foes has arrived!
		[*] Contract Abilities: Starting abilities are now phased rewards through Contract Abilities.
		[*] Crafting Upgrades: Smart synthesis hints + one-click formula application!
		[*] Contract Point Recycling: Added ratio indicators for clarity.
		[/list]

		[h3]Fix Problem[/h3]

		[list]
		[*] Abnormal purchases in Contract Shop (specific conditions).
		[*] Missing co-op supply node prompts (edge cases).
		[*] Skill display glitches (rare scenarios).
		[*] Localization issues and smelting-related bugs.
		[*] Inventory overflow now triggers warnings.
		[/list]

		[h3]Other Adjustment[/h3]

		[list]
		[*] Streamlined in-game menus.
		[*] Revamped character unlock conditions.
		[/list]

notes.title: Contract of Swarm Hunter 0.0.5 Update
Contract of Swarm Hunter 0.0.4 Update
Contract of Swarm Hunter 0.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with multiplayer games not starting the game correctly!
New skills and 1 new character will be launched soon, so stay tuned!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]fix problem[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with windows not filling up correctly;
[*] Fixed the ability selection problem in special cases;
[*] Fixed an issue where multiplayer games could not start the game correctly;
[/list]

[h3]Other Adjustment[/h3]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the differences between different difficulties. Now there is no limit on the optional abilities in simple tasks, which means you can choose advanced abilities such as Heavenly Thunder, Embers, Soul Devour, Ice Explosion, etc.!
[*] Overhealing change to: each 1s, Restore 3% shield. but All restoration effect amplification -50%;
[/list]

notes.title: Contract of Swarm Hunter 0.0.2 Update
notes.content:
The next update will usher in new skills, so stay tuned~

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]new content[/h3]

[list]
[*] Ancient Leaf of Life
[*] Sealed Red Crystal
[*] Reddish Wolf Fang
[*] Shield Overclock Device
[*] Shield Stabilizer
[/list]

[h3]fix problem[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed the problem of not being able to enter online rooms correctly from Steam invitations
[*] Fixed the conflict between Lucky Blessing  Ⅱ and Lucky Blessing  Ⅲ
[*] Fixed the problem that the deceleration value of Frostbolt is too high
[*] Fix other border issues
[/list]

[h3]Other Adjustment[/h3]

[list]
[*] Composure is changed to defense +15%, crit +15%, attack speed -5%;
[*] Berserk is changed to attack speed +20%，crit +10%，defense -5%；
[*] Shield Bash is changed to every 100 shields: extra damage+50% (maximum 200%);
[*] Defense Breakthrough * Fortress：damage taken change to -5%；
[*] High-Energy Crystal change to damage +40%，crit +10%，attack speed -5%；
[*] Trigger Mutation increase damage rate to 25%;
[*] Overhealing change to each 1s restore 2% shield；
[*] Reduce the probability of recruit training and advanced training；
[*] The upgrade capabilities of life regeneration, life drain, damage taken and movement speed have been increased in quantity limit, and the values ​​have been fine-tuned.
[*] Reduce threat reduction and dangerous battle intent to high-level props；
[*] Removed collection frenzy series props；
[*] Other props to fine-tune text；
[/list]

notes.title: Our Game Demo Is Now Live – Play Now!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that our game demo is now available on Steam! This is your chance to experience the core gameplay, explore our unique world, and get a taste of what’s to come.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3328360/_Demo/]Play Demo[/url]

We warmly invite you to dive in, have fun, and share your thoughts with us. Your feedback is incredibly valuable and will help us refine and enhance the game as we move toward the full release.

Looking ahead, we’re excited to share our plans for the next update, which will include:
[list]
[b][*] Brand-new characters with distinctive abilities.
[*] Fresh skills to add more depth to the gameplay.
[*] Innovative mechanics that will challenge and surprise you.[/b]
[/list]
Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to hear what you think!
